title: AIPT shared config v1 canonical schema (AIPT-M0-B004, leaf 2)
description: The single authoritative AIPT shared-config schema root (JSON Schema 2020-12), consumed by the Go service internal/config and shared with the Web UI and the CLI/Launcher (R7-Q001). Every object schema in this document sets additionalProperties=false recursively, so unknown fields fail closed at every level. The root is executable: schema is the frozen aipt.config/v1 marker, profile is exactly development|production (R7-Q007), database is required with a URI-form PostgreSQL DSN (whose database must equal the declared identity), an explicit database identity, an SQL namespace, and a positive bounded ping_timeout_ms, and evidence is required with an explicit namespace. Written against the explicit dependency-free subset implemented by scripts/ci/lib/json-schema.mjs.

schema.title: Configuration schema marker
schema.description: The frozen strict JSON object schema marker. Any other value fails closed via const equality.

profile.title: Configuration profile
profile.description: Exactly the two frozen profiles; development and production use independent databases and evidence namespaces (R7-Q007).

database.title: Database configuration
database.description: The required database object. dsn is a URI-form PostgreSQL DSN (scheme postgres/postgresql, a host, and a database) whose database must equal the declared identity; identity is the explicit canonical database name; namespace is the SQL namespace (schema); ping_timeout_ms is a positive bounded integer.

dsn.title: URI-form PostgreSQL DSN
dsn.description: The raw DSN is private: the Go consumer keeps it inside the database value and exposes it only through the launcher-only DSN accessor; every diagnostic rendering emits [REDACTED].

identity.title: Explicit database identity
identity.description: The canonical database name the DSN must name. Lowercase unquoted PostgreSQL identifier.

namespace.title: SQL namespace
namespace.description: The SQL namespace (schema) of the database. Lowercase unquoted PostgreSQL identifier.

ping_timeout_ms.title: Ping timeout
ping_timeout_ms.description: Positive bounded ping timeout in milliseconds. Values outside the inclusive range fail closed.

evidence.title: Evidence configuration
evidence.description: The required evidence object with an explicit namespace. Development and production must use different evidence namespaces (R7-Q007).

namespace.title: Evidence namespace
namespace.description: Explicit evidence namespace: lowercase namespace identifier; dots, underscores, and hyphens are allowed as separators.
